Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card` (a maintainer request)
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds. On `origin/main`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is 178 lines with a Chinese governing body and a non-governing `## English summary`, and `AGENTS.md:206` cites 「路上的功能点」 / 「优先级」.
Serial constraints: PR #28773 (#28638, this seat's, awaiting approval) touches `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L74 and `references/execution-duties.md`. The North Star references this card renames are on other lines. Whichever lands second merges `main`; no line is shared. No other open PR touches the surface.
Landing: Tier H by the card (`.github/CODEOWNERS`, the `north-star` governed row). `.claude/**` is Tier S by the register, so the stricter path applies. The PR stays draft with `needs-user-decision` until an authorised approver acts.
